meta_description: OYM Trilogy 2026 Leg 2: September 27 at Ayala Triangle, Makati. 21K to 5K series leg from OYM.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 at Ayala Triangle Gardens in Makati, this OYM series leg offers four distances. Registration pending.
verdict: OYM Trilogy 2026 Leg 2 is part of the OYM multi-leg running series at Ayala Triangle Gardens — Makati's premier urban park in the heart of the Philippines' financial district. Four distances (21K, 16K, 10K, 5K) with the unusual 16K mid-distance. The series format gives it competitive structure across multiple events. September in Makati is the tail of the wet season. A solid Makati series race for Manila's running community.
